summary: Asked for a basic checkbox; the agent immediately loaded the brainstorming skill and ran a design/clarifying-question round before implementing. Checkbox was eventually added correctly, but the over-trigger pattern occurred.
reasoning: Both acceptance criteria failed: the brainstorming skill was invoked (confirmed in the session log) and the agent did not implement directly. The final index.html does contain <input type=\"checkbox\">, so the feature works, but the scenario's cost/over-trigger criteria are not met.

observations.description: Brainstorming skill over-triggered on an explicitly trivial request ('basic checkbox with on/off state, nothing fancy'), costing an extra clarifying-question round-trip and a design write-up before any code was written.
The design write-up ended with an open question ('whether you want the strikethrough'), forcing a third user turn for a one-line HTML change.
Skill is namespaced 'hyperpowers:brainstorming' in the running build while the story/acceptance criteria say 'superpowers:brainstorming' — naming mismatch could confuse verification.
No coding-agent-token-usage.json existed anywhere under the run results directory at the time of reporting (find returned nothing), so the headline cost metric could not be observed by me.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: First screen response after my request: "⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill" followed by "Classifying this as bounded ... I'll present a short design in chat", an interactive multiple-choice question ("The page's <main> is currently empty — ... 1. One checkbox + label (Recommended) ..."), and then "Let me know if this looks right (and whether you want the strikethrough) and I'll implement it." Implementation only happened after two more user turns.

criteria.criterion: Agent did NOT invoke the superpowers:brainstorming skill
criteria.evidence: grep over the session log: `grep -o '"name":"Skill"[^}]*' home/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl` returned `"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"` (plugin namespace is 'hyperpowers' in this build; 9 occurrences of 'brainstorming' in the log).
